meta.description: WeekPaper, the Gama Institute video series breaking down one research paper every week.

hero.h1: One research paper, broken down every week

featured.title: When a simple prompt can attack your database
featured.body: We explore Prompt-to-SQL Injection (P2SQL) attacks, where an attacker manipulates an LLM connected to a database into generating and running malicious SQL queries itself, and LangShield, a defense-in-depth approach built around the LLM.

subscribe.lead: A new episode every week. Get the email alert or follow the channel.

contribute.body: Students and community members can present a paper related to one of our five research axes: AI and machine learning, software engineering, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and responsible and trustworthy AI. You don't need to be an expert: you only need to understand the paper well enough to explain its ideas accurately.
contribute.structure_label: Recommended GAMA structure, or propose an innovative one

structure.title: Intro
structure.desc: A realistic situation or engaging question, the paper, and why the problem matters.

structure.title: Key concepts
structure.desc: The essential terms and ideas needed to follow the research.

structure.title: Methodology
structure.desc: What the researchers did and how they evaluated their approach.

structure.title: Results
structure.desc: The most important findings and what they mean.

structure.title: Discussion & implications
structure.desc: Practical lessons, limitations, future directions. Your interpretation, kept distinct from the authors'.

structure.title: Question to the audience
structure.desc: An open question that invites viewers to share their perspective.

contribute.cta_body: Video, editable slides, YouTube title and description, photo and bio. GAMA reviews every contribution before publication.

submit.title: Submit a WeekPaper presentation
submit.sub: Presentation in French, slides in English. GAMA reviews every contribution before publication.
submit.name: Full name
submit.bio_hint: A few sentences about your background and interests.
submit.photo_hint: JPG or PNG, 5 MB max. Used in the video thumbnail, even if your face does not appear.
submit.video_hint: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or WeTransfer. Presentation in French.
submit.slides_hint: PowerPoint (.pptx), 15 MB max, made with the GAMA template, in English.
submit.yt_desc_hint: The topic, what viewers will learn, the paper reference and link.

yt-li.title: YouTube and LinkedIn
yt-li.desc: GAMA publishes the video on YouTube and shares it on LinkedIn.

yt.title: YouTube only
yt.desc: GAMA publishes the video on YouTube, without sharing it on LinkedIn.
